description: Approves $13,517.50 heritage funding for 925 5th Avenue North.
Funds exterior painting and wood pillar repairs over three years.

chips.text: Approved
Committee questioned if proposed repairs would prevent future deterioration and funding requests.
The property owner at 925 5th Avenue North receives the grant.
The full extent and long-term integrity of the pillar repairs remained unclear.
Administration can approve additional funding under $10,000 if unforeseen issues arise.

description: Committee discussed Civic Heritage Policy review, including intangible heritage.
Committee also discussed city artifacts and their storage.

chips.text: Recommended
Property owners hesitate due to concerns about heritage designation restrictions.
Staff stated administration clarifies information
Committee questioned the city's role in mitigating financial barriers for heritage properties.
A resident refused heritage designation due to concerns about interior paint restrictions.
Concern raised about city promising undeliverable financial tools for heritage properties.
Discussion highlighted intangible heritage's connection to Indigenous storytelling and place-making.
Staff committed to report back on intangible heritage and policy language barriers.

description: Administration to prioritize Heritage Plan and Official Community Plan.

chips.text: Approved
